# Aegntic OS V2

> A local multi-agent outcome workspace for briefs, creative approvals, Pi Durable execution and pre-launch evidence. Public work in progress; MIT licensed with retained attribution. Updated 2026-10-17.

## Public project facts
- [Overview](https://github.com/aegntic/aegntic-os-v2/blob/main/README.md): features, architecture, status, quickstart and FAQ.
- [Machine-readable facts](https://github.com/aegntic/aegntic-os-v2/blob/main/project-facts.json): declared capability states and evidence references.
- [Execution](https://github.com/aegntic/aegntic-os-v2/blob/main/EXECUTION.md): Pi Durable integration, trusted-local boundary and recovery.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/aegntic/aegntic-os-v2/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): planned versus connected services.
- [Build log](https://github.com/aegntic/aegntic-os-v2/blob/main/BUILD-LOG.md): dated implementation and verification records.
- [Creative kickoff](https://github.com/aegntic/aegntic-os-v2/blob/main/CREATIVE-KICKOFF.md): aesthetic and launch-package review.
- [Assembly](https://github.com/aegntic/aegntic-os-v2/blob/main/launch-site/README.md): separate local launch-site review and waitlist.
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/aegntic/aegntic-os-v2/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): attribution and dependency boundaries.
- [Licensing](https://github.com/aegntic/aegntic-os-v2/blob/main/LICENSING-STATUS.md): MIT license and attribution scope; preserve third-party grants.

## Limits
Convex, Cloudroom app integration, additional providers, publishing and mobile distribution remain unconnected. Local model execution is not an OS sandbox. No public launch or current throughput benchmark is asserted. Private continuation content is not part of this index.
